WITH Rolling_Window AS
(
    SELECT 
		FullDate 
    FROM eds.DATE_DIM
        INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL
            ON FULLDATE = CCD_DATE
    WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
)
, DEP AS
(
    SELECT
		 EDA.AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE
		,ORGKEY AS CUSTOMER_ID
		,COUNT(FORACID) AS ACCT_CNT
	FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
	INNER JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
		ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
		AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
	INNER JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
		ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID
		AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE ='9999-12-31'
	INNER JOIN Rolling_Window AS RW
		ON EDA.AS_OF_DATE = RW.FullDate
	WHERE 
		EDA.DEL_FLG = 'N'
		AND EDA.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
		AND EDF.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
		AND GAM_ACID IS NOT NULL
		AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		AND (DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C')
		AND LEFT(ECD.ORGKEY,1) = 'R'
	GROUP BY 
		EDA.AS_OF_DATE
		,ORGKEY
)
, LNS AS 
(
    SELECT
		A.AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE
		,C.ORGKEY AS CUSTOMER_ID
		,COUNT(B.FORACID) AS ACCT_CNT
    FROM EDS.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN A
	INNER JOIN EDS.LOAN_FACT B
		ON A.AS_OF_DATE = B.AS_OF_DATE
		AND A.ACID = B.GAM_ACID
		AND A.BANK_ID = B.GAM_BANK_ID
	INNER JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM C
		ON C.SCD_END_DATE ='9999-12-31'
		AND A.CUST_ID = C.CORE_CUST_ID
		AND A.BANK_ID = C.BANK_ID
	INNER JOIN Rolling_Window AS RW
		ON A.AS_OF_DATE = RW.FullDate
    WHERE A.DEL_FLG = 'N'
        AND A.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
        AND B.GAM_ACID IS NOT NULL
        AND (LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C')
        AND A.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		AND LEFT(C.ORGKEY,1) = 'R'
	GROUP BY 
	    A.AS_OF_DATE
		,C.ORGKEY
)
, FCBS_ACCOUNT AS
(
	SELECT AS_OF_DATE,CUSTOMER_ID,ACCT_CNT FROM DEP WHERE ACCT_CNT > 0
	UNION ALL
	SELECT AS_OF_DATE,CUSTOMER_ID,ACCT_CNT FROM LNS WHERE ACCT_CNT > 0
)

SELECT 
CC.CUST_CIF_NBR AS [CIFID],
CC.CUST_FIRST_NAME AS [First_Name],
CC.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME AS [Middle_Name],
CC.CUST_LAST_NAME AS [Last_Name],
CP.PHONEOREMAIL AS [Type],
(CASE WHEN CP.PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL' THEN CC.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR ELSE NULL END) AS [Email_Value],
(CASE WHEN CP.PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE' THEN  CONCAT(CC.CUST_MOBILE_CTY,CC.CUST_MOBILE_AREA,CC.CUST_MOBILE_PHONE) ELSE NULL END) AS [Phone_Value],
(CASE WHEN CP.PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE' THEN CC.CUST_MOBILE_PHONE ELSE NULL END) AS [Local_Code],
(CASE WHEN CP.PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE' THEN CC.CUST_MOBILE_AREA ELSE NULL END) AS [City_Code],
(CASE WHEN CP.PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE' THEN CC.CUST_MOBILE_CTY ELSE NULL END) AS [Country_Code],
CC.INSERT_DTTM AS [Last_Update_date],
CP.EMAIL FCBS_Email_Value,
CONCAT(CP.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE,CP.PHONENOCITYCODE,CP.PHONENOLOCALCODE) FCBS_Phone_Value,
CP.PHONENOLOCALCODE  AS [FCBS_Local_Code],
CP.PHONENOCITYCODE AS [FCBS_City_Code],
CP.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE AS [FCBS_Country_Code]

FROM Rolling_Window AS RW
INNER JOIN
	EDS.CCD_CUSTOMER CC
	ON RW.FullDate BETWEEN CC.SCD_START_DATE AND CC.SCD_END_DATE
INNER JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CD 
	ON CC.CUST_CIF_NBR = CD.ORGKEY
	AND LEFT(CC.FILE_NAME,5) =  CD.BANK_ID
	AND CC.CUST_FIRST_NAME = CD.CUST_FIRST_NAME
	AND COALESCE(CC.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME,'A') = COALESCE(CD.CUST_MIDDLE_NAME,'A')
	AND CC.CUST_LAST_NAME = CD.CUST_LAST_NAME
	AND CAST(CAST(CC.CUST_DTE_BIRTH AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE) = CAST(CD.CUST_DOB AS DATE)
	AND CD.SCD_END_DATE ='9999-12-31'
INNER JOIN EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL CP
	ON CC.CUST_CIF_NBR = CP.ORGKEY
	AND CP.PHONEEMAILTYPE IN ('OACEML','OTPPH')
WHERE 
	LEFT(CC.FILE_NAME,5) = 'CBC01'
	AND 
	(CASE 
		WHEN CP.PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL' AND CC.CUST_EMAIL_ADDR <> CP.EMAIL THEN 1
		WHEN CP.PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE' AND  CONCAT(CC.CUST_MOBILE_CTY,CC.CUST_MOBILE_AREA,CC.CUST_MOBILE_PHONE) <> CONCAT(CP.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE,CP.PHONENOCITYCODE,CP.PHONENOLOCALCODE) THEN 1
		ELSE 0 
	END) = 1
	AND CC.CUST_CIF_NBR NOT IN 
	(
		SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM FCBS_ACCOUNT
	)
	AND CP.INSERT_DTTM < CC.INSERT_DTTM
